classification.rationale: A master services agreement defining services, fees, service levels, term and termination between a client and a provider.

summarization.headline: Cobalt Software Solutions will support Northwind Logistics' fleet-tracking platform for $18,500 per month.
key_points: Fixed fee of $18,500.00 per month, payable within 30 days of invoice.
99.9% uptime guarantee with 5% service credit per percentage point missed.
Initial term February 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026, renewing yearly.
summarization.term: February 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026; renews automatically for one-year periods
key_obligations: Provider maintains the platform with 24/7 incident response and monthly releases
Client pays $18,500.00 per month within 30 days of invoice
summarization.termination_terms: Non-renewal with 60 days' written notice; termination for material breach not cured within 30 days.
